firmwareDropdown.description: Firmware versions offered in the FW update dropdown, as semver ranges per product. The rule used is the one with the highest fromBazecor that is <= the running Bazecor version. A product missing from a rule shows every version. Custom firmware is never filtered. Upper bounds end in -0 (e.g. <2.0.0-0) so the next major's betas are hidden too: in semver 2.0.0-beta.1 is lower than 2.0.0.

sk20.description: Superkeys 2.0: Bazecor shows the SK 2.0 UI instead of the legacy dual-function/superkeys UI.

lens.description: Layer Lens: needs the firmware to report overlay/layer packets over raw HID. Raise never exposes it.

combos.description: Combos: the Combo Editor, the combo settings card and the combo badges in the Layout Editor. Hidden on older firmware.

autoshift.description: Autoshift: the Autoshift settings card and the 'Make it Autoshiftable' checkbox in the key picker. Hidden on older firmware.

capsword.description: CapsWord: the CapsWord settings card and the CapsWord key in Layers & modifiers. Hidden on older firmware.

altRepeatLayerHold.description: Hold until layer change on previous-key rule outputs (Sonsei fork). Shown only together with capabilities.altRepeat and capabilities.layerHold, which come from help. v1.2.2 has both commands but rejects hold outputs.

altRepeatKeyRepeat.description: Apply on key repeat on previous-key rule tabs (Sonsei fork). Shown only together with capabilities.altRepeat, which comes from help. v1.2.2 and v1.2.3 have the command but reject a previous key with the repeat flag.

swapHandsSuperHold.description: Swap hands Hold on a Superkey's hold action (Sonsei fork). Shown only together with capabilities.swapHands, which comes from help. v1.2.10 has the command but ignores swap keys sent by a Superkey.

repeatKeyRules.description: Previous-key tabs on the Repeat key (Sonsei fork). Shown only together with capabilities.repeatKey and capabilities.altRepeat, which come from help. v1.2.17 stores the rules but never applies them.

repeatKeyTapRules.description: Previous-key tabs on a dual-function Superkey whose tap is the Repeat key (Sonsei fork). Shown only together with capabilities.repeatKey and capabilities.altRepeat, which come from help. Older firmware stores the rules but never applies them on that tap.
